title: Companion planning and configuration after a cold start
description: D07 candidate, not native acceptance. Requires separate authorization, fresh fixture/native/source/recording preflights, one reserved device and one deliberate app restart. Prove five planning collections in actual warm/cold views and four observed memory-only reads. No provider/runner launch or UI/cache/SQL injection. Independent target-at-press video audit remains required. Accepted D06 records stay immutable.

proofTargets.claim: Owning backlog, graph and queue APIs plus roadmap/project file writers update mounted current Companion views without Refresh.
A new offline process restores exact backlog, roadmap, project, work-graph and queue rows with original SQLite observation times.
All five planning views visibly report actual saved data age after cold restoration.
The actual fully visible disabled Mark ready control receives one paired AX/OCR-guarded press and sends no command on outage or recovery; independent press-video audit remains required.
Actual mounted PR and stopped Co-Pilot consumers issue their four read-only queries; only these observed memory-only methods are checked absent from SQLite.
